messages:
ben: Quick heads-up — we need a swift hotfix for 1.12.3. We're seeing occasional tail latency blips traced to kvcache timeouts. Plan is a tiny timeout reduction and a version bump. Target cutoff ~45m. Who can review and smoke?
sara: I can open the PR and add a short changelog line. Will keep the change to a single cherry-pick.
priya: QA can run the smoke. I have a free slot in ~15m, will queue on qa-cluster-1.
dave: Ping me when PR is ready. I can do a quick review, no full E2E unless smoke flags something.
amanda: Any chance this needs infra work / restarts? DB migrations?
ben: No migrations. Basic plan:
```
- bump package.json -> 1.12.3
- change kvcache default timeout: 1200 -> 800 (ms)
- tiny changelog note
```
Diff should be < 8 lines. No config toggles.
sara: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5420 (branch: hotfix/kv-timeout) — title: "hotfix(kvcache): reduce timeout for tail latency"
ci-bot: CI started for PR #5420 — jobs: unit, lint, smoke.
dave: Quick pass — left one nit about a comment. No functional issues. Approving once that is addressed.
sara: Nit fixed and force-pushed. Requesting review from @dave and @priya for smoke.
ci-bot: Unit and lint passed. Smoke suite queued on qa-cluster-1.
priya: Starting smoke now, ETA ~10m. Will report failures here.
deploy-bot: On green smoke, staging deploy will run. Preparing tag v1.12.3-kvfix.
priya: Smoke ✅ — critical flows (generation, kv get/set, routing) look stable, no regressions.
dave: Approved. Good to merge from me.
ben: Merging now. Cutoff reminder: 30m left but fine since this is minimal and smoke passed. Oncall @li please monitor the rollout window.
li: Got it — dashboards up. Setting alert-style watch: error-rate and P95 tail latency. Will report if >2x baseline.
sara: Merged and pushed release notes to releases/notes/1.12.3-kvfix.md. Tag and CI will kick deployment shortly.
ci-bot: Staging deploy completed and smoke in staging passed.
deploy-bot: Scheduling prod rollout in 4m. Rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 25m with automated canary checks.
li: Canary 5% healthy. No anomalies in logs or metrics.
ben: Thanks all. Please monitor closely for the next 30m. If anything odd, we will rollback.
sara: Release tag: v1.12.3-kvfix pushed. Changelog notes mention the timeout tweak and reason.
deploy-bot: Prod rollout completed to 100% — monitoring window active.
li: Prod stable after 20m watch. No regressions observed. Metrics look nominal.
ben: Closing thread — hotfix done, no postmortem needed. Will add a short note in the release thread.
sara: Added a brief note in #release-notes and the changelog. Thanks team!"
